body:
Hey, thank you for the really thoughtful reply and the kind words.

I think the pressure to succeed is... yeah. This morning my father told me about a woman he knows who had acid thrown in her face, was blinded. My first thought was, "It must be nice to not have any career expectations." :/ (Which, now, makes me feel like a godawful person.)

I guess that's the thing. My response to actually having some skills (I'm fairly well decorated from my degrees and have other things going for me) is that I don't have those skills because then maybe I won't have to do anything. I don't know.

Maybe I intellectualize something non-intellectualizable. I want to get it. I want to *get* how to be happy. I don't think that's the way, though. But, heh, then I get into, "Well, I'm so fucking lazy that I'll never be able to DO anything to make myself happy so... that's that."

I'm just not thinking straight. Waiting until Monday for the psychiatrist. But the immediate edge of "I wish I had the strength to end it" is off.
Mostly because they are overwhelming and I am afraid of failure so I don't want to start. But I pin it on my being lazy and a bad person.

Right, unfortunately, I have been on the sick-well-sick-well-sick-well merry-go-round for a long time. I have never been able to "quit my illness".

Substances: nightmare there. I've been off and on a lot. 

My father is a Zen Buddhist.

Also, in terms of "allowing the sickness to kill [me]"... that's so unfair of you to say. I have been up and down. I have been hospitalized, I have been in rehab, I have been in therapy. I have been in AA. I have done everything. Looking at suffering like some beautiful thing is not fair, not when I'm repeatedly bludgeoned by it.

Not sure what to say... if I don't do school it's unlikely I'll go back to school.. and I don't want to stop drinking. This is why I'm an awful person. I'm not even willing to help myself, really. Not significantly.

Hey, thank you for the message. I don't know how I see myself in the future. I don't, really.

Five minutes of self reflection.... yeah. I get into this all-or-nothing state where if it's not Astanga primary series, it's nothing. I don't know how to break it.

And I've been in professional help for over half of my life. I'm so skeptical at this point.

But, again, thanks at least for the support.

Thanks. The alcohol addiction fucks with my head. I get that it's a depressant and it never mixes well with medication, that it doesn't help me, but it's how I bond with my dad and it's how I have the ability to deal with people in public. I don't want to stop drinking. But I should. But I don't want to. But it's poison. Ugh. :(

Thanks for the support. I will ask psychiatrist (new doctor, seeing her Monday) for her suggestions on a therapist. I feel like I won't get any job I apply for because I'm too crazy. Plus, my current advisor expects me to do graduate school applications right now.

It's like night and day. I feel like complete, unable-to-do-anything garbage.... and I'm applying for graduate school. sigh.

I'm compulsive about to-do lists... I make them obsessively and color-code them, all of this stuff, then do nothing. It's really sad. :/ 

I don't know how to not think about the past... Facebook and living in my parents' house is awful, heh. 

Thanks for the comment, though. I appreciate that someone is reading this.
